speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. You are here with a chest skin lesion; can you tell me how long it has been there and if it is changing in size, shape, or color? Also, have you noticed any pain, itching, or bleeding from it?

speaker: Patient
text: 63-year-old male. The patient reports noticing a skin lesion on his chest 2 months ago, which he believes has increased in size. He denies any associated pain or itching with the lesion. He has a medical history significant for type 2 diabetes mellitus, hypercholesterolemia, and glaucoma.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Basal Cell Carcinoma. Given the patient's age, 2-month duration with size increase, lack of symptoms, and chest location, this clinical picture is highly suspicious for non-melanoma skin cancer. I will request a biopsy for definitive histopathological confirmation.
